name: AirPlay 2 Speaker
description: Makes this kiosk an AirPlay 2 speaker that joins multi-room groups and plays in sync with HomePods and other AirPlay 2 speakers, using shairport-sync and NQPTP. Follows Kiosk Satellite's media volume, ducks while the assistant listens or speaks, and shows the track in Now Playing through a small companion app the plugin installs itself. AirPlay 2 timing needs UDP ports 319 and 320: where Android won't let the app open them, NQPTP runs with root (su, such as Magisk). Not affiliated with Apple.
author: Kieran Waugh

settings.title: Speaker name
settings.description: The name in the AirPlay menu of an iPhone, iPad or Mac.

settings.title: Sync offset (ms)
settings.description: Moves playback against other speakers in a group. Negative plays earlier. Tune by ear with a HomePod in the same room.

settings.title: Follow the media volume
settings.description: Caps AirPlay at Kiosk Satellite's media volume, the same way as its own players. The sender's volume still works within it.

settings.title: Duck to (%)
settings.description: AirPlay's level while the assistant listens, thinks or answers. 100 turns ducking off.

settings.title: Log sync statistics
settings.description: Writes shairport-sync's sync figures to the app log every few seconds.
